name: Malignant Style
descriptionText: Malignant Style is focused on disrupting enemy turns and making their life miserable.

abilities.name: Malignant Style
abilities.rulesText: Whenever a character, that you are Attached to, heals or gets a Shield, you steal half of it (rounding down).

actions.name: Sap Life
actions.rulesText:
Steal 2 HP from the Attached character.
9+: Steal 1 more HP and give 1 Weakness and 1 Fatigue Tokens.

actions.name: Overtake Body
actions.rulesText: Force the Attached creature to Move up to 2. Additionally, if the Attached character has Speed Tokens, you can make them spend up to 2 of them to move even further.
